attestations.text: HO Kuo-tsung 何國宗 (T. 翰如, 約齋), d. 1766, official and mathematician, was a native of Ta-hsing (Peking). After passing his chin-shih examination in 1712 he was appointed a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy and was ordered to study mathematics.
何國宗，字翰如，順天大興人。

accounts.evidence: 何國宗，字翰如，順天大興人。康熙五十一年進士，改庶吉士，命直內廷學算法。五十二年，命編輯律曆淵源。未散館，授編修。三遷至庶子。雍正初，授侍讀學士，再遷至內閣學士。
